jobs.title: Associate Software Doveloper
jobs.description:
HCLTech – Associate Software Developer Job Description

As an Associate Software Developer at HCLTech, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining software applications based on business and client requirements. The role involves writing clean and efficient code, understanding technical specifications, developing new features, fixing bugs, troubleshooting application issues, and collaborating with other developers and technical teams. You may also be involved in database operations, API development, application testing, documentation, and supporting existing software systems. The role requires good programming knowledge, problem-solving and analytical skills, understanding of OOPs, Data Structures and Algorithms, SQL/DBMS, web technologies, REST APIs, Git, and the ability to learn and work with different technologies according to project requirements.
requirements: Requirements & Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication Engineering, or a related technical field.
Strong knowledge of Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript, with a good understanding of OOPs, Data Structures & Algorithms, SQL, and DBMS.
Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, REST APIs, Git/GitHub, and web development is an added advantage.
Good problem-solving, analytical, communication, teamwork, and debugging skills with a willingness to learn new technologies.
Freshers and candidates with limited experience may be eligible depending on the specific HCLTech job opening.
